description: This file defines the MetadataEnvelope class within the Aws\Crypto namespace. It provides functionality for storing and managing encryption metadata, including header constants, data handling using traits, and interfaces for array access and JSON serialization.

classes.name: MetadataEnvelope
classes.description: A class that stores encryption metadata for reading and writing, implements interfaces for array access, iteration, and JSON serialization, and manages internal header constants.

methods.name: getConstantValues
methods.description: Returns a list of all predefined constant header names used within the class.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a value for a given header constant if it is valid; throws an exception otherwise.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Prepares the encryption metadata data for JSON serialization.
